cohort: 3,701 nulliparous and multiparous women in Czech Republic
finding: While SUI at 6 weeks postpartum was initially slightly associated with PD at 6 months, and PD at 6 weeks was not significantly related to new SUI at 6 months, after full adjustment for confounding factors, these relationships were not significant.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery and parity were associated with SUI.
